entries.gave: Read docs/product-vision.md as the accounting team and maintainers meet it: two roles (accountant, installer), O1 and O2 with two key results each, a ranking line, and a concept with three ideas.

Read N4 (a how-well and a how-fast key result per objective, each with its better direction, ranked, no targets, countable from an E2E run) and N5 (objectives distinct so each piece of work serves one) with their reasons and practices.

N4 good: O1 and O2 each have a share-that-fails key result and a time key result with the role own time, each Lower is better, how-well ranked first, no targets. N5 good: O1 (accountant prints correct invoices) and O2 (installer readies the machine) are reached apart, and KR1.1 counts only where the command runs, so setup work serves O2 alone and printing work O1 alone.
Both conditions of the group answered in answers-1.json; ending with done.
